service.ur: مواقف امپاؤنڈ سے گاڑی کی واپسی

about: Collect a vehicle impounded for breaking Abu Dhabi parking law.
note: Requirements read from the official Abu Dhabi Mobility page on the checked date. The release is handled in person, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Vehicle owners or their legal representatives
A first degree proof is needed if the owner's name differs from the registered name
documents: Owner's Emirates ID or driving licence
First degree proof if the name differs or a representative collects it
fees: AED 100 per day for the first month from the impound date
AED 500 per month for each later month
timing: Vehicles not freed within 6 months go to auction
channels: In person at the customer service centre in the impound area, Karama, Sheikh Rashid Bin Saeed Street
